messages:
maria: Quick q — should the rerank endpoint return normalized probs (0-1) or allow raw logits? Product asks because customers threshold on confidence and console expects bounded values. :thinking:
ali: My vote: keep logits as canonical from models. Normalizing on small candidate sets is noisy and hides model behaviour. We can offer server-side calibration as an opt-in.
jen: Product POV: customers want a stable "confidence" number in the UI. If we expose logits, we need a standard mapping or a metadata flag so console can show consistent bars.
kai: Proposal: response includes `score`, `score_type` and `model_version`. `score_type` in {"logit","prob","calibrated"}. Also include `calibration_meta` when present. Example:```json
{"candidates":[{"id":"c1","score":-0.72,"score_type":"logit","model_version":"v3.2"}]}
```
sam: Also need to decide billing/quota unit: do we charge per-candidate evaluation or per-request? Right now our console shows tokens + calls, but rerank costs spike with candidate count.
ali: We currently have ambiguity. I suggest per-candidate "score unit" for billing AND an optional per-request cap. E.g. cost = base_call + candidate_count * unit. That maps well to Dedicated capacity planning.
maria: UX: console should show a candidate histogram and an "expected cost" estimate when you toggle candidate_limit in rollout. We need telemetry to compute P(client candidate distribution) not just averages.
jen: Rollout UX: canary should be able to route X% of requests to new model but also limit fanout (num candidates) separately for canary. Otherwise a canary could blow budget.
kai: For routing: add `routing_hint` header like `X-Rerank-Model: prefer=v3.3, fallback=v2.9` so runtime can pick compatible variants. Also surface `model_affinity` in traces.
ops-bot: deploy 1723456795: canary routing flag gate-rerank-model-v3.3 enabled for 5% traffic.
sam: Telemetry sampling: sample 100% of canary scores (for drift detection) and ~1% of production. Add `sampled_for_eval:true` tag in trace entries. Console should show canary vs baseline score distribution.
ali: Backcompat: if older clients expect 0-1 probs we can offer server-side `score_type=prob` conversion controlled by request param or header. But warn customers about calibration drift.
maria: Decision checklist: (1) add `score_type` field, (2) define billing as base+per_candidate unit, (3) console candidate histogram + expected cost, (4) routing_hint header and model_affinity traces, (5) telemetry sampling rules for canary.
jen: I'll update the product brief and docs. sam — can you mock console tiles for candidate histogram + cost knob?
sam: Yep — I'll drop a quick mock in #design by EOD and include sample telemetry panels. :white_check_mark:
ali: I'll prototype `X-Rerank-Score-Type` request header and server-side conversion. PR incoming.
kai: I'll add `calibration_meta` and an example eval pipeline to the model onboarding checklist.
maria: Great. Follow-ups: add a small migration note for existing customers and a console banner when their routes switch score_type.
jen: +1. Thanks team.
thread_summary: short decision thread about reranker output semantics: add score_type, support logits+probs+calibrated, per-candidate billing unit, console histogram and expected-cost UX, routing_hint header, and telemetry sampling rules for canaries
